title: File:Coral (Acropora hemprichii), Ras Katy, Sharm el-Sheij, Egipto, 2022-03-26, DD 108.jpg
desc: Acropora hemprichii, Ras Katy, Sharm el-Sheikh, Red Sea, Egypt. This species of acroporid coral is found in shallow reefs in marine environments, occurs at depths of 3 to 15 m (9.8 to 49.2 ft), and lives for between 13 and 24 years.
